Yara Li: Need a tight solution brief for enterprise buyers focused on SLAs, security, and a migration path. One-pager + gated HTML.
Ben Holt: I'll draft copy. Quick ask: what single benchmark line can we lead with that doesn't overpromise?
Mina Rao: Use comparative language: 'Dedicated = most predictable P95; Private = lowest amortized unit cost; Hosted = fastest to evaluate.'
Alex Ford: Product confirms P95 ranges we can show: Hosted ~90-170ms, Dedicated ~45-85ms, Private ~80-160ms. Avg tokens/test = 132.
Yara Li: Good. For the gated form fields keep it minimal: email, name, company, title, company_size, deployment_interest, compliance_needs, accept_contact. Add hidden asset_id.
Ben Holt: Draft CTA: 'Request a Dedicated Demo' and alternate 'Talk to Solutions Engineering' when compliance flags present. I'll include a short AE email snippet.
Mina Rao: Add a 3-step migration playbook: evaluate (2 weeks), pilot (1-2 weeks), rollout (prod cutover checklist). Include expectations: SE sizing within 2 biz days.
Alex Ford: Include reproducibility snippet in appendix: './run_eval --model redwood-dedicated-v2 --workload chat --seq-min 50 --seq-max 300 --samples 100000 --capture p50 p95 cost_per_million'
AssetBot: Reminder: upload copy + chart to /marketing-assets/enterprise by 2891240000.
Yara Li: Routing pseudo-rule for HubSpot to include: if deployment_interest=="private" or compliance_needs contains "FedRAMP" -> assign Enterprise AE + notify SE, elif company_size >=100 -> Mid-Market AE, else -> SDR nurture.
Ben Holt: I'll avoid pricing numbers, use percent ranges and qualitative language. Draft ready by EOD; can someone review design quick tomorrow?
Mina Rao: I will review the methodology appendix for accuracy. Let's keep messaging direct and honest so AEs have fewer follow-ups.
Yara Li: Thanks team. We'll run a short review at 2891243600 and finalize gating/workflow after that.
